import { openDb } from "../server/src/platform/db.ts";
const db = openDb(process.argv[2]!);
try {
  db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE"); process.send?.({ kind: "held" });
  await new Promise<void>(resolve => { const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 3000); process.once("message", () => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(); }); });
} finally { if (db.inTransaction) db.exec("ROLLBACK"); db.close(); process.disconnect?.(); }
